design_notes: Registry-first context pass for WikiTable-style benchmarks.
Keep lightweight extractors primitive: lexical intent, table shape, numeric/date/value surfaces, header/cell overlap, and scoped native metadata.
Do not encode semantic entity ontology atoms such as country/team/player/name-role categories.
Targeted rule text is evaluated first as a bundled rule-pack feature, not explicitly triggered by these atoms.

Superlative/ranking wording such as most, highest, first, last.
Comparative wording, usually X than Y.
Difference, ratio, percent, or arithmetic wording.

Temporal wording or explicit year/date mention.
Negation markers.

Header includes rank/place/position/seed/round cues.

explicitly_excluded.name: schema.has_entity_col
explicitly_excluded.reason: Encodes semantic entity ontology such as country/team/player; too heavy for the lightweight primitive layer.

explicitly_excluded.name: text.answer_role_entity
explicitly_excluded.reason: Task interpretation / answer-role inference, not a primitive surface attribute.

explicitly_excluded.name: schema.has_identifier_col
explicitly_excluded.reason: Can be useful later, but behaves like schema-role semantics rather than primitive context.

explicitly_excluded.name: country/team/player/name-role atoms
explicitly_excluded.reason: Would make the extractor a hand-built domain ontology.

bundled_rule_pack_experiment.policy: evaluate as a normal feature first; no explicit context-triggered routing in v1
rule_surface: Preserve complete score/result/record cells unless the question asks for margin, side, total, or difference.
Treat hyphenated numeric spans as intervals only when the column semantics support date/year/duration/range.
Keep percent and unit markers attached; compare values only under the same unit.
Resolve date/year wording against date-like columns and compare chronologically.
Treat rank/place/position as ordinal and decide direction before comparison.
For previous/next/before/after anchored to a cell, move by displayed row order.
For follow-up references, resolve the prior answer set before scanning the table.
